title: 1D polar phonons: collapse of the LO-TO splitting in BN nanotubes

decision_points.fork: Which boundary conditions describe an isolated tube: the 3D-periodic runs (3D_code) or the 1D-cutoff runs (1D_code); and whether the ph.x Gamma frequency is the 3D q->0 LO
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the 3D-periodic dispersion (finite LO-TO splitting at Gamma, bulk-like) for the isolated tubes; or report the analytic Gamma frequency as the 3D q->0 limit
decision_points.consequence: LO +95/+93 cm^-1 at 0.01|GZ| and +46/+40 at 0.05 (BN55/BN66); 3D q->0 value low by 100 cm^-1

decision_points.fork: Asymptotic form of the dielectric shift: constant (3D), linear in q (2D) or q^2 ln(1/qt) (1D)
decision_points.wrong_choice: 2D-like linear collapse omega^2 = omega_G^2 + B q, B from the purchasable explicit 0.15|GZ| run of the hidden tube

decision_points.fork: Standard Fourier interpolation of the 1D force constants versus subtracting and re-adding the 1D long-range term; the archived BN(4,4) 1D_code interpolated dispersion is itself a plain interpolation (no long-range term), 33 cm^-1 below its own explicit 1D runs at 0.05|GZ|, visible only by cross-checking
decision_points.wrong_choice: Trust matdyn-like plain interpolation (or validate against the archived BN(4,4) interpolated dispersion)

decision_points.fork: Radius and dielectric constant of the cylinder model: the extent of the electronic polarization (about 1.4-1.9 times the atomic-shell radius, or the authors' d/4) with eps1d = A(eps_zz - 1)/(pi t^2), versus the atomic-shell radius or the vacuum-diluted cell eps_zz used as the material constant
decision_points.wrong_choice: Atomic-shell radius (6.6 and 7.9 bohr) with the polarizability per length conserved; or eps1d = eps_zz of the cell (1.46) at the calibrated radius
decision_points.consequence: Shell radius: LO +6.6/+7.8 at 0.05 and +8.8/+10.2 at 0.075 cm^-1. Cell eps: +5.9/+5.3 for BN66 at 0.1/0.125 (thin margin; passes for BN55)

decision_points.fork: Full Bessel-function cylinder kernel versus its small-qt asymptotic form (the paper's q^2 ln q expansion) as the long-range term of the interpolation
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use the asymptotic form everywhere; it grows without bound at the grid q-points, so the subtracted long-range part is wrong

decision_points.kind: discriminating data under budget / regime of validity
decision_points.fork: Whether the Gamma run alone (analytic model with a constant short-range part, the paper's Eq. 2) suffices, or the 1D grid of each hidden tube must be bought to capture the mechanical dispersion
decision_points.wrong_choice: Gamma-only model D_Gamma + 1D long-range term at all q

decision_points.fork: q conversions (archived 2pi/alat with alat the lateral cell; |GZ| = pi/L) and the Rydberg e^2 = 2 of the long-range prefactor
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take q/|GZ| as a fraction of 2pi/L; or use e^2 = 1 with Rydberg force constants

decision_points.fork: The 3D-periodic q->0 shift is set by the vacuum-diluted eps_zz of the supercell and the supercell volume, not by the cylinder model, the perpendicular component or no screening
decision_points.wrong_choice: Cylinder dielectric constant eps1d = A(eps_zz - 1)/(pi t^2) in the 3D term (or with the tube volume; or eps_xx; or eps = 1)
decision_points.consequence: 3D q->0 LO 1383.1 (cylinder eps), 1615.9 (cylinder eps and volume), 1445.1 (eps_xx), 1464.7 (unscreened) vs 1420.4 cm^-1

decision_points.fork: Whether the polar shift curve is a property of the BN tube family or depends on each tube's mode charge per length and radius
decision_points.wrong_choice: Add the released BN(4,4) explicit shift curve to the hidden tube's Gamma LO
decision_points.consequence: LO -6.9/-11.5 at 0.05 and -7.8/-12.7 at 0.075 cm^-1 (scaling by the mode charge per length is worse: +7.5/+17 at 0.05)

length_estimate.why: Parsing raw QE dynamical-matrix files of 16-24-atom tubes, building a 1D long-range-corrected axial interpolation, choosing and validating the cylinder radius on a released tube, budgeted purchases across 12 folders, and the 3D artefact.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy of the runtime image (lab only decompresses and serves archived files)

data_provenance.hidden_truth: Archived explicit 1D DFPT runs of BN(5,5) and BN(6,6) below 0.15|GZ| (longwave folders) and the q->0 point of the archived BN(5,5) 3D-periodic matdyn.modes; stored only in environment/lab/private/

notes: Truth = the authors' explicit DFPT runs. The authors' own 1D-corrected interpolation (reproduced by the construction code to <0.15 cm^-1 for BN(5,5) and BN(6,6)) differs from them by up to 2.2 cm^-1, which sets the scale of the defensible-method spread. A fitted effective radius is not graded: the fit is shallow (t from 9 to 12.5 bohr for BN(5,5) passes all checks) and model dependent.
